blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateCustomerAccountCreation`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates the input data for creating a customer account.
The step throws an error if:

- The email is missing
- A customer with the email already exists and has an account
- A guest customer with the email already exists

children.name: CreateCustomerAccountWorkflowInput
children.description: The details of the customer account to create.
